repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait on Button2 before executing the brightness adjustment. The candidate polls the condition at the start of the body (line 2) but fails to block until the edge occurs. Evidence F2 shows the button was already 'pushed' at t=100ms, yet the JoI emitted no action because the `if` guard was evaluated at t=0 when the button was null, and the rising-edge logic was missing.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with a rising-edge state machine: persist `fired` state, block until the condition becomes true if previously fired, block until true if not fired, execute body, then mark fired. This ensures the action occurs exactly when the rising edge is detected, matching the IR's `wait(..., rising)` semantics.
